definitions: NBS end-year stock, UK households (S.14); WAS April 2020 to March 2022, GB, SCAPE-based DB valuation

nbs_line: S.14 net financial assets BF.90 (incl pension entitlements)
definitions: NBS financial assets include pension and insurance entitlements (AF.6) and are net of all liabilities including mortgages; WAS net financial excludes property debt

nbs_line: S.14 non-financial assets (produced AN.1 + non-produced AN.2)

nbs_line: S.14 non-financial assets (produced AN.1 + non-produced AN.2), again
was_line: WAS net property + ONS 3222 personal property debt + physical
definitions: tests the gross reading: 3222 property debt (individuals, GB, summed over regions) added back to WAS net property; the 3222 population (persons) and what it counts as property debt may differ from the WAS household net property definition
